queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: One search per keyword or job title, e.g. python developer, nurse, accountant, warehouse operative.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional town, city, county or postcode, e.g. London, Manchester, Kent, LS1. Empty searches the whole UK.

distanceMiles.title: Distance (miles)
distanceMiles.description: Optional radius around the location: 0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 50. Reed's default is 10.

searchUrls.title: Or Reed search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search pages copied from reed.co.uk/jobs with your filters already set. Filters below do not apply to these.

jobTypes.title: Job type
jobTypes.description: Any of: permanent, contract, temporary, full_time, part_time. Empty keeps all.

workingOption.title: Remote / on-site
workingOption.description: Keep only remote, hybrid or on-site jobs.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Only jobs posted in this window. Use Today or Last 3 days on a schedule to collect new jobs.

employerType.title: Posted by
employerType.description: Keep jobs posted by direct employers, or by recruitment agencies.

graduateOnly.title: Graduate jobs only
graduateOnly.description: Keep only jobs Reed marks as suitable for graduates.

hideTrainingJobs.title: Hide training courses
hideTrainingJobs.description: Drop training-course listings that Reed shows among jobs.

includeDetails.title: Full description and skills
includeDetails.description: Reads each job page for the full description, skills, postcode, region, sector, salary per annum and recruiter reference. Costs $0.002 per job instead of $0.001.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many jobs. Reed shows 25 per page and lets you page to the end of every search.
